description: NaTh₂(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.68-2.91 Å. Th is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Th-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.68 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.58 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Th and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Th and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Th and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Th, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Th, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Th, and one P atom.
